newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share volumes gain, Unibanka leads.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share volumes gain, Unibanka leads.

text.p: Trade on the Latvian stock market was buoyant on Tuesday, with Unibanka the most actively traded but remaining stable.
Overall market turnover was 82,203 lats versus Friday's 57,697 lats. Unibanka turned over 50,760 lats of shares and was unchanged at 2.40 lats.
Other official list shares were quieter with Riga Transport Fleet at just 1,206 lats and slipping to 96 santimes from one lat and Staburadze down one santime to two lats on 2,464 lats.
Jekabpils Sugar led the secondary list on trade of 8,153 lats and it rose to 40 santimes from 36 santimes.
Daugavpils Chain was also active on trade of 6,591 lats and rose to 1.14 lats from 1.13 lats while Riga Yeast rose nine percent to three lats on business of 3,081 lats.

Other stocks saw trade of around 2,000 lats, including the Roja fish cannery on 2,032 lats as it was unchanged at 1.50 lats and Salacgriva '95 on 2,300 lats and a price of 2.30 lats, 10 santimes higher.
Kaija fish cannery turned over 2,146 lats and rose one santime to 1.16 lats from 1.15 lats.
